info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of education enrollment certificates associated with various learners. It serves as a resource for educational institutions, enabling them to access and manage certification data efficiently. Typical consumers of this API include administrators and educators seeking to verify student certifications or analyze enrollment trends. The endpoint supports querying for certificates based on specific criteria, ensuring that necessary information is readily available for decision-making and reporting purposes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about enrollment certificates. It provides all necessary data related to the certificate associated with a specific enrollment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the enrollment certificate information. It should contain the necessary details to identify the specific certificate you wish to fetch.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesRequ.description: This schema represents the request body for operations related to enrollment certificates. It is a string type, used to convey specific enrollment-related information.
